ruleDefinitions.name: PUA - SoftPerfect Netscan Execution
ruleDefinitions.description:
Detects usage of SoftPerfect's "netscan.exe". An application for scanning networks.
It is actively used in-the-wild by threat actors to inspect and understand the network architecture of a victim.

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\netscan\\\.exe$") OR process_product = "Network\ Scanner" OR process_description = "Application\ for\ scanning\ networks")
